episodes.title: Brave
episodes.summary: Iris welcomes an enigmatic ally to their community while Hope questions the visitor's motives. A message upends the sisters' worldview, forcing them to decide between the safety of their home and the uncertainty of the world beyond.

episodes.title: The Blaze of Gory
episodes.summary: The group adjusts to the reality of life beyond their community's walls. Iris attempts to take charge, in spite of Hope's reservations. Felix and Huck trail the teens while Felix is forced to confront unwanted memories.

episodes.title: The Tyger and the Lamb
episodes.summary: In the face of a massive obstacle, the teens face pressure to return home.

episodes.title: The Wrong End of a Telescope
episodes.summary: Members of the group bond while facing threats inside an old high school.

episodes.title: Madman Across the Water
episodes.summary: The group must cross a river; a plot to turn the group around hits a snag.

episodes.title: Shadow Puppets
episodes.summary: A newcomer arrives, offering a deal that creates divisions within the group.

episodes.title: Truth or Dare
episodes.summary: The group searches for something that will help their quest; the teens play a game of truth or dare.

episodes.title: The Sky is a Graveyard
episodes.summary: A horrific discovery finds the group at a crossroads and prompts one of them to revisit past trauma.

episodes.title: The Deepest Cut
episodes.summary: An accident slows the group; someone suffers an injury while another makes a discovery.

episodes.title: In This Life
episodes.summary: A divided group struggles to reunite; others set their sights on the greater good.

episodes.title: Konsekans
episodes.summary: Hope's commitment to the future is tested; Iris and Felix meet a new group.

episodes.title: Foothold
episodes.summary: While some attempt to cover their tracks, others acclimate to their new surroundings.

episodes.title: Exit Wounds
episodes.summary: An attempted grift leads to a precarious situation; Huck is given an ultimatum as she readjusts to her old life.

episodes.title: Family Is A Four Letter Word
episodes.summary: Tensions run high within the group; someone's loyalties are put to the test.

episodes.title: Quatervois
episodes.summary: As a dangerous plan is put into motion, more revelations come to light.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.summary: A member of the group becomes the target of an investigation.

episodes.title: Blood and Lies
episodes.summary: The group searches for answers while others react to a surprising message.

episodes.title: Returning Point
episodes.summary: A new plan is set into motion; a relationship is leveraged; others are forced to take action.

episodes.title: Death and the Dead
episodes.summary: Truths are revealed and allegiances are tested as the group faces off against the CRM.

episodes.title: The Last Light
episodes.summary: The group faces enemies, living and dead, on their way to save the future... and themselves.
